question: Why did the error rate go up on 04 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: The error rate spike coincides with a high error rate alert.
why_chain: The error rate spike is also reflected in a high error rate alert.
This alert suggests that the error rate increase is a known issue, not a new problem.
The alert occurred 10 minutes before the change, indicating a possible correlation.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate is due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: The request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase is due to a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: There is no evidence of a configuration change that would cause the error rate to spike.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service auth in region eu-west rose from 0.51% to 3.23% (+534%), with a change point at 2026-03-04T08:50:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service auth in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.10).
At the same time, request volume for service auth in region eu-west stayed about the same (373 per 5 min before, 460 per 5 min after, +23%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service auth in region eu-west stayed about the same (90 ms before, 91 ms after, +2%).
High error rate on auth in eu-west (auth, eu-west; 10 min after the change; record R013)
